missionPremise: Every surface tells the customer the same thing about one parcel's envelope: the drawing route (POST /api/brokerage/v1/place/buildable-envelope) owns the envelope's reason and its resolved table, and every surface reads that answer instead of composing its own, or says as a declared state that it could not reach it.

scopeBasis: Rulings 14/15/16 in _decisions/2026-09-18_phase0_closeout_rulings.md; subjects table and measured classes in the dispatch.

instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.SAYS-RULES-UNRULED-BESIDE-RULED-TABLE: ruledAxes(facets.setbacks) >= 3 AND any scanned surface text contains one of RULE_REFUSAL_PHRASES = [unruled, no ruled table, rules pending, no setback rule, 'setback table (unknown)', 'setback table unknown']
instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.SAYS-GEOMETRY-WITHHELD-BESIDE-DRAWN-GEOM: draw route geometryPresent === true AND the text does NOT match saysOutlineDrawn (/outline is (modelled|modeled|drawn)|drawn for reference|outline is served|outline served/i) AND the text contains one of GEOMETRY_REFUSAL_PHRASES = [depth-warm geometry withheld, geometry withheld, geometry unavailable, envelope geometry withheld, atom_path_pending, atom-path-pending, no envelope geometry, geometry pending]
instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE: facets.setbacks (4-tuple, nulls significant) !== draw.setbacks (4-tuple). NO conflict-row exemption exists in this predicate.
instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.IMPERVIOUS-DUAL-FIGURE: facets.envelope.maxImperviousPct != null AND facets.maxImperviousCoverPctFact.percent != null AND they differ.
instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.saysOutlineDrawn: the ONLY sanctioned way to keep a withhold phrase on the wire beside drawn geometry; P-249's honest shape (48309:103015, 48209:97658) matches it and must stay byte-identical.
instrumentPredicates_read_verbatim_from_.glossary: the MCP smartSiteVocabulary glossary is excluded from scanning by the seat; do not 'fix' it.

consequence_for_design: P-339 is satisfiable by wording + ownership ONLY where the phrase is a claim the route denies. The panel's own composed string at atom-chain-to-facets.ts:2503 carries BOTH refusal phrase classes while its payload serves a 4/4-axis table and the route draws: that single string produces both findings on 4 parcels.

P-340 is NOT satisfiable by declaration alone: PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE has no conflict-row exemption, so the card's served 4-tuple must EQUAL the route's 4-tuple. A declared conflict row is the P-154/P-270 honesty floor, not a pass for this class.
P-341 is satisfiable only by serving the governing (lower) figure as the envelope's maxImperviousPct; deleting either figure would hide law and is refused.

reasonComposingSites.what: composes the panel envelope disclosure for the warm-verify-decline + codified-table branch
reasonComposingSites.defect: two refusal claims beside what the payload and the route actually serve: '(unknown)' fires RULE_REFUSAL 'setback table (unknown)' for 48453:239852 / 48453:445501 / 48453:367134 / 48491:R405006 / 48491:R483884 / 48491:R580151; 'depth-warm geometry withheld' fires GEOMETRY_REFUSAL for 48021:51735 / 48453:239852 / 48453:445501 / 48453:367134 while place/buildable-envelope returns 6/38/5/7 vertices for the same parcels
reasonComposingSites.disposition: rewrite to the route-owner wording: name the jurisdiction or name the absent STAMP (never 'setback table (unknown)'); replace the geometry-withheld claim with the saysOutlineDrawn form and state that depth-warm promoted geometry is not consumed; carry reasonOwner

reasonComposingSites.what: applyEnvelopeSetbackOverride appends its own overrideNote to the envelope disclosure and rewrites envelope.setbacks from the record's axes
reasonComposingSites.currentText: `Reader-composed axis override (parcel_record) applied to one or more setback axes; other axes remain atom-chain-sourced.${dateNote}`
reasonComposingSites.defect: the card resolves its own table for the same parcel the route resolves, which is the measured mechanism of PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE (48453:367134 card 25/5/10/15 vs route 15/3.5/5/10; 48209:* card omits the corner the route serves)
reasonComposingSites.disposition: the served table must be the route's resolution (P-340); the override note survives only as a sourced provenance sentence about WHERE the winning axes came from, never as the tile's table when the route answered

reasonComposingSites.what: sets envelope.maxImperviousPct straight from the zoning rule's own sub-field
reasonComposingSites.defect: 48453:367134 serves 45 while the watershed fact serves 30; the customer reads two 'impervious cover' figures
reasonComposingSites.disposition: serve the governing (lower) figure, cite both with their sources (ruling 16)

reasonComposingSites.what: stripCortexEnvelopeProductTruth writes a hardcoded declined envelope (declineReason 'atom_path_pending')
reasonComposingSites.defect: a declared state, but one whose token is a GEOMETRY_REFUSAL phrase; it is honest only while the route also cannot draw. It is the surface that CANNOT reach the property atom chain, so it stays a declared state and must say so.
reasonComposingSites.disposition: keep the decline, re-word the token to a declared unreachable state that names the owner; do not let it look like a claim about the parcel's rules

reasonComposingSites.what: envelopeOverlay: when no modelled ring resolves, serves {state:'refused', reason: envelopeRefusalReason ?? 'atom_path_pending'}
reasonComposingSites.defect: measured on every subject: draw.overlays envelope reads reason 'atom_path_pending' + reasonDisplayText 'Withheld, setbacks unruled' (envelopeHuman from atom-contract) while the payload's own table row prints the 4-axis table and the route draws. This single overlay produces the MCP text half of BOTH phrase classes on 48055:27929, 48209:145880, 48309:103015, 48453:239852, 48453:367134, 48453:445501, 48491:R405006/R483884/R580151.
reasonComposingSites.disposition: the overlay's reason must be the drawing route's answer; when the route drew but this surface cannot project the ring, say so as a declared state (outline served, projection unavailable) and never re-assert 'unruled'

reasonComposingSites.what: envelopeReason(refusal) composes the reason from the BAKE's own refusal, defaulting to 'atom_path_pending'
reasonComposingSites.defect: the bake is not the owner; ruling 15 names the route. atomPathPending() at line 77 is the same predicate the propertyExplorer gate keys off, so one change must carry a divergence test against its callers.
reasonComposingSites.disposition: thread the route's answer in as an input; bake answers only when the route was unreachable, and then as a declared state

reasonComposingSites.what: the tier-1 bake's honest decline, declineReason 'atom_path_pending'
reasonComposingSites.defect: not a defect in itself (P-249 anti-zombie), but it is the source of L2's default and therefore must stop being the served reason wherever the route answered
reasonComposingSites.disposition: leave the bake's record intact; stop serving it as the reason

declaredStates.rule: A surface that cannot reach the route's answer says so as a declared state; it never falls back to its own composition.
new: envelope-route-unreached — the surface could not read place/buildable-envelope; carries the owner name and the read that failed. Chosen so it hits NEITHER RULE_REFUSAL_PHRASES nor GEOMETRY_REFUSAL_PHRASES: the phrase list is the instrument's contract and a legitimate unreachable state must not be mistakable for a refusal claim about the parcel.
envelope-route-declined:<route reason> — the route answered and declined; the route's own token is served verbatim, never re-composed.
declaredStates.forbidden: any phrasing containing 'unruled', 'setback table (unknown)', 'no ruled table', 'rules pending', 'no setback rule', 'geometry withheld', 'atom_path_pending' beside a parcel whose payload rules >= 3 axes or whose route drew.

entries.fact: on the artifact of record the three P-339/P-340/P-341 classes measure 4 / 8 / 7 / 1 instances over 52 scanned legs (SAYS-GEOMETRY / SAYS-RULES / PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE / IMPERVIOUS-DUAL-FIGURE); XD-2 OPEN with 1 of 41.
PANEL-DRAW-TABLE-DISAGREE has NO conflict-row exemption in scripts/surface-probe.mjs; the two 4-tuples must be equal, so a declaration alone cannot clear the class.

saysOutlineDrawn (outline is modelled|drawn, drawn for reference, outline is served|served) is the ONLY sanctioned way to keep a withhold phrase beside drawn geometry; the P-249 parcels already use it.
the panel's measured contradiction is produced by ONE string at atom-chain-to-facets.ts:2503 plus ONE appended note at pe-property-atoms.ts:546; fixing either alone leaves the class firing.

envelopeHuman('atom_path_pending') = 'Withheld, setbacks unruled' lives in the PUBLISHED @empressaio/atom-contract/display package consumed by three repos: the repair is to stop serving that token where the route answered, NOT to edit the shared vocabulary.

a fixture-mode (--fixtures) probe run cannot grade the OPS-24 classes: ops24LegsByBucket is built only when NOT --fixtures (surface-probe.mjs:2915). A passing artifact for these classes requires a live run. Do not cite a fixtures artifact as a live grade.

this lane does not deploy or merge, so the close will cite the artifact of record with FAIL verdicts for these classes plus the live runs to be made after the seat deploys. closed-partial, never 'closed'.

designDecisions.owner: place/buildable-envelope owns both the reason and the resolved table; the panel and the MCP read it.
designDecisions.panelReadStrategy: the card's served 4-tuple must be the route's 4-tuple; the card keeps its own resolution ONLY as a declared, sourced fallback when the route is unreachable, and in that case serves the conflict row rather than a silent pick.
designDecisions.wordingStrategy: never delete a true statement to clear a phrase list: re-attribute it. A withhold stays on the wire whenever it is still true, in the saysOutlineDrawn form whose control is 48309:103015.
designDecisions.vocabularyBoundary: no new token is added to @empressaio/atom-contract; new declared-state tokens are local wire states, chosen outside both refusal phrase lists.
